full_prompt_en: A square impressionistic oil painting looks straight down a narrow garden pool toward a vivid cobalt-blue house. The water begins at the lower edge and leads centrally to a small sunlit landing before the building. Its rippled surface reflects saturated blue walls, dark green plants, and little yellow flecks. On either side, thick tropical greenery presses inward: feathery palms, long drooping leaves, spiky plants, layered shrubs, and small yellow blossoms. A tall brown palm trunk rises at the right, while a curtain of hanging leaves frames the upper left. Beyond the pool, the house has broad flat blue volumes, a shaded porch with slim columns, a balcony, and an upper terrace. Deep indigo recesses sit beneath the overhangs, and a narrow bright patterned trim runs across one wall. The building is recognizable, but its edges are softened by visible brushwork rather than measured architectural drawing. Sunlight filters through foliage from above, producing small warm highlights on leaves, path edges, and the water. Shadows are deep teal and blue, while the sky and some palm fronds appear pale and luminous behind the roofline. The paint is worked in quick short strokes and layered color patches, especially in the dense plants and moving reflections. Cobalt and ultramarine form the dominant saturated blocks; foliage adds emerald and olive, with restrained ochre and yellow accents. No people or lettering appear. The whole image feels like a secluded, sun-warmed oasis, its strong central reflection leading the eye through tactile greenery into the cool blue retreat.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形印象派油画沿狭长花园水池直望鲜亮钴蓝房屋。水从下边缘开始，居中引向建筑前一小块受日照的平台。轻波表面倒映饱和蓝墙、深绿植物与细小黄点。两边厚密热带绿植向内挤：羽状棕榈、下垂长叶、尖刺植物、层叠灌木和小黄花。右侧一根高棕榈树干升起，左上悬叶像帘子框住画面。水池后，房屋由宽阔平面的蓝色体块组成，有细柱支撑的阴影门廊、阳台和上层露台。深靛凹处位于挑檐下，一条窄亮花纹边横过墙面。建筑仍可辨，却被可见笔触软化边缘，而非精确建筑测绘。阳光从上方穿过树叶，在叶、路边和水面上制造小暖高光。阴影是深蓝绿与蓝色，屋顶后天空和部分棕榈叶则淡而发亮。颜料以快速短笔触和叠层色斑处理，密植与动荡倒影尤其明显。钴蓝和群青构成主导饱和色块，绿植加入祖母绿与橄榄色，赭黄与黄色点缀克制。没有人物或字样。整幅图像像隐蔽、被太阳烘暖的绿洲，强烈中央倒影把目光穿过有触感的绿植，引向冷蓝静居。
style_prompt_en: Luminous impressionistic oil painting sets broad saturated cobalt and ultramarine planes against densely worked emerald and olive textures. Short visible strokes soften geometric edges, while layered dabs and long feathery marks build organic depth. A narrow central reflective band carries broken blue, green, and yellow color vertically toward a brighter middle distance. Deep indigo recesses make the surrounding blues glow, and filtered sunlight scatters small warm highlights without harsh shadow outlines. The composition is enclosed by abundant side texture yet remains open along its bright central route. Tactile paint and strong complementary area control create a cool, luxuriant, sunlit atmosphere.
style_prompt_zh: 明亮印象派油画让宽阔饱和钴蓝与群青平面面对密集加工的祖母绿和橄榄肌理。可见短笔触柔化几何边缘，层叠点色与长羽状痕建立有机纵深。狭窄中央反射带载着断续蓝、绿、黄纵向通往更亮的中远处。深靛凹处让周围蓝色发亮，过滤日光散落小暖高光而没有生硬阴影轮廓。构图被丰富侧边肌理围合，却沿明亮中央通路保持开放。有触感的颜料与受控的强色面积造出冷色、丰茂、日照充足的气氛。
theme_en: A vivid cobalt-blue house reflected in a lush garden pool
theme_zh: 鲜亮钴蓝房屋倒映在繁茂花园水池中
name: Jacques Majorelle
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
